title: Invariant Features in Language Models: Geometric Characterization and Model Attribution
abstract: arXiv:2605.06458v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Language models exhibit strong robustness to paraphrasing, suggesting that semantic information may be encoded through stable internal representations, yet the structure and origin of such invariance remain unclear. We propose a local geometric framework in which semantically equivalent inputs produce representations that occupy structured regions in latent space, with paraphrastic variation along nuisance directions and semantic identity preserved in invariant subspaces. Building on this view, we make three contributions: (1) a geometric characterization of invariant latent features, (2) a contrastive subspace discovery method that separates semantic-changing from semantic-preserving variation, and (3) an application of invariant representations to zero-shot model attribution. translated_title: 语言模型中的不变特征：几何刻画与模型归因
translated_abstract: 语言模型对改写表现出很强的鲁棒性，这表明语义信息可能通过稳定的内部表示进行编码，但这种不变性的结构和来源仍不清楚。我们提出了一个局部几何框架，其中语义等价的输入所产生的表示占据潜空间中的结构化区域，改写引起的变化沿着干扰方向进行，而语义同一性则在不变子空间中得以保持。基于这一观点，我们做出了三项贡献：(1) 对不变潜在特征的几何刻画，(2) 一种对比子空间发现方法，能够将改变语义的变化与保持语义的变化分离开来，(3) 将不变表示应用于零样本模型归因。跨模型和跨层的实证结果支持了这些贡献。不变结构在特定的深度区域中涌现，语义位移……（原文摘要不完整）
tldr: 该论文提出一个局部几何框架来刻画语言模型中的不变特征，通过对比子空间发现方法分离语义改变型与语义保持型的表示变化，并将所得的不变表示成功应用于零样本模型归因任务。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a local geometric framework for characterizing invariant features in language models, introduces a contrastive subspace discovery method that separates semantic-changing from semantic-preserving variation, and applies these invariant representations to zero-shot model attribution.
